zh: 我认为芯片厂商与前沿实验室之间的动态关系有一点值得注意，以 Fractal 为例，我们尽量与前沿的需求保持最大程度的一致。

speaker: Unknown
en: We try to look a bit like some of those teams as well.
zh: 我们也尽量让自己看起来有点像那些团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have people that really think deeply about these workloads and so on.
zh: 我们有真正深入思考这些工作负载的人员等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of the cases that I think we sometimes need to make is explaining why we believe that over multiple decades, the world sustains some kind of frontier third-party chip players.
zh: 所以我认为我们有时需要论证的情况之一，就是解释为什么我们相信在数十年的时间里，世界会维持某种前沿的第三方芯片玩家。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why does this not just roll up into these labs?
zh: 为什么这不会直接被并入这些实验室？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that comes down to the kind of asymmetric game that all of these labs and frontier players have to play, where they're exposed to an enormous risk if they go all in on a hardware bet.
zh: 我认为这归结为所有这些实验室和前沿玩家都必须玩的一种不对称博弈，他们在硬件押注上全力投入的话会面临巨大的风险。

speaker: Unknown
en: Suppose I'm lab one and I've gone all in on some proprietary silicon, and then lab two discovers some new computational breakthrough that delivers far better computational efficiencies for the same level of intelligence, but it only works on the chip that they've decided to deploy.
zh: 假设我是实验室一，我已经在某种专有硅片上全力押注，然后实验室二发现了某种新的计算突破，能在同样的智能水平上带来好得多的计算效率，但它只在对方决定部署的那款芯片上有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: I could die in the nine months before I get to deploy enough of that chip that I've also now gained that kind of 5X in computational efficiency.
zh: 在我部署足够多的那款芯片、从而也获得那种 5 倍计算效率提升之前的九个月里，我可能会死掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so there is a really urgent need for these chips to actually deploy these companies to deploy the same platforms as one another.
zh: 所以确实存在一种非常迫切的需求，让这些公司彼此部署相同平台的芯片。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're playing different games, right?
zh: 他们在玩不同的游戏，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: They're trying to now compete in the model where I think having deeply differentiated bets and going all in on those differentiated bets at the chip player is...
zh: 他们现在试图在模型层面竞争，我认为作为芯片玩家，做出深度差异化的押注并在这些差异化押注上全力投入是……

speaker: Unknown
en: Sort of an irrational and a very dangerous move for anybody that is playing at the frontier.
zh: 对于任何在前沿竞技的人来说，都是一种不理性且非常危险的举动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I think that's a great place to end.
zh: 好的，我认为这是一个很好的收尾点。
